text: RB CI-101 [Build / Gradle]: Gradle dependency resolution timeout on NexusRM. Verify corporate proxy settings, clear corrupted ~/.gradle/caches/modules-2, and pin internal Nexus mirror URL.
RB CI-102 [Registry / NexusRM]: Nexus Repository Manager 401/403 Unauthorized during artifact upload. Rotate expired CI service token in Harness Secrets Manager and verify deploy-role RBAC.
RB CI-103 [Security / AquaScan]: Aqua Scan pipeline gate blocked on CRITICAL CVE in base image. Upgrade base image to distroless-java21-nonroot, rebuild via Jib, and re-trigger vulnerability scan.
RB CI-104 [Quality / SonarQube]: SonarQube Quality Gate failed on new code coverage < 80% and cognitive complexity. Add JUnit 5 parameterized tests for uncovered branches and re-run analysis.
RB CI-105 [Container / Jib]: Jib daemonless container build failed with registry blob upload EOF. Enable -Djib.httpTimeout=120000, verify GCR/ACR workload identity token, and retry.
RB CI-106 [SecretLeak / Pipeline]: Pipeline log exposed hardcoded registry token or SSH key. Immediately revoke compromised token, scrub build log history, and enforce pre-commit gitleaks hook.

RB CI-107 [Deploy / Harness]: Harness Kubernetes canary rollout stuck in ProgressDeadlineExceeded due to readinessProbe HTTP 503. Roll back release to previous verified artifact tag and inspect Spring Actuator health.
RB CI-108 [GitOps / Helm]: Helm chart template render error on nil pointer in values-prod.yaml. Validate chart locally with helm lint --strict and restore missing secretRef block.
RB CI-109 [Runner / EphemeralPod]: Azure DevOps / Harness ephemeral build pod evicted for ephemeral-storage exhaustion. Prune Docker layer cache and mount 20Gi emptyDir scratch volume.
RB CI-110 [Compliance / SBOM]: CycloneDX SBOM attestation signature verification failed during prod promotion. Re-sign container digest with Cosign KMS key and attach provenance.
